_comment: Byte-exact encode/decode pairs for the Pico->ESP SAFETY_CMD_FW_VERSION (0x0B, Frame C) payload, per docs/LINK_PROTOCOL.md sec 6. payload_hex is the raw command payload as it would sit inside kilnlink_frame_t.payload -- it does NOT include the outer frame header/CRC/stuffing, which is kilnlink_frame's job (see frame_vectors.json). Same shape as announce_vectors.json (kilnlink_announce.h explicitly documents Frame C as its own mirror, truncated at boot_id), extended with config_version/config_crc. Generated by hand-computing struct.pack('<H') in Python and cross-checked against kilnlink_fw_version_encode/decode in test/test_fw_version.c.

vectors.name: clean_full
vectors.note: A typical build stamp: protocol 7, min_compatible 5, clean build, non-empty commit and datetime strings, nonzero boot_id, a commissioned config (version 3, crc 0xBEEF).

vectors.name: dirty_no_strings
vectors.note: dirty=1 (uncommitted or unknown build) with empty commit/datetime strings, config_crc=0 (never commissioned, running compiled-in defaults).

hostile_vectors.name: wrong_cmd
hostile_vectors.note: Byte 0 is 0x0F (ANNOUNCE_VERSION's id, the ESP->Pico mirror of this frame's layout), not 0x0B.

hostile_vectors.name: length_mismatch_commit_claimed_longer_than_present
hostile_vectors.note: commit_len (offset 6) says 7 bytes of commit hash follow; the 12-byte buffer only has 5 bytes left after the fixed prefix, so datetime_len's own offset (7+7=14) falls past the end -- a length byte that promises more than actually arrived.

hostile_vectors.name: length_mismatch_datetime_claimed_longer_than_present
hostile_vectors.note: commit_len=0 (fine), datetime_len (offset 7) claims 20 bytes follow, but the 12-byte buffer has none left -- total declared wire length (32) doesn't match the actual 12.

hostile_vectors.name: string_too_long
hostile_vectors.note: commit_len (offset 6) = 0xFF, past KILNLINK_FW_VERSION_MAX_COMMIT_LEN (64) -- must be rejected before treating it as a real length, even though it fits in a u8.
